$comment: Model-facing output schema for POST /ai/organize. Uses only the structured-outputs subset: no minLength/maxLength/pattern, additionalProperties:false. Empty string means 'no value'; the server converts it to null before replying to the client and validates formats itself.

candidates.description: One entry per distinct task found in the user's text. Empty array if none.

title.description: Short, clean task title in Korean, imperative or noun phrase, at most about 60 characters. Keep names and terms from the user's text.

description.description: Extra context from the user's text only. Empty string if there is nothing to add. Never invent details.

subtasks.description: Concrete steps only if the user's text states or clearly implies them. Usually empty.

list.description: Target list only if the text says when it should be worked on. Otherwise 'unspecified'.

due_date.description: Deadline as YYYY-MM-DD resolved against the provided current date and timezone. Empty string if the text gives no deadline.

due_basis.description: 'explicit' if the text states the deadline (e.g. '금요일까지'); 'inferred' if you are guessing from weak hints; 'none' if due_date is empty.

due_quote.description: The exact phrase copied from the user's text that gives the deadline. Empty string if due_basis is 'none'.

no_task_reason.description: If candidates is empty, a one-sentence Korean explanation for the user (e.g. what was unclear). Otherwise an empty string.
